integrity: The original 1992 publication date and bibliographic record were verified. A complete open 2012 same-object article was inspected across its equilibrium, Hopf-bifurcation, center-manifold, and control sections; searches found no invariant-measure, moment, or variance theorem. A complete 2013 same-object PDF was inspected through the Genesio equations, jerk reduction, equilibria, Hopf analysis, Lyapunov-exponent calculations, and coexisting-attractor discussion; document-wide searches found no variance, moment, average, or invariant-measure formulation. A 2025 mathematical treatment was checked for the exact equations, global/integrability scope, and primary MSC 34C23, with publisher full-text access unavailable. The barycenter parabola, endpoint rigidity, fiberwise regression, speed defect, and correlation formula were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is conditional on compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not establish strange-attractor existence for arbitrary parameters.
The barycenter parabola fixes only the first two moments of \(x\), not the full invariant distribution.
The heightwise regression fixes only the conditional mean of \(x^2-cx-by\) given \(z\).
The complete 1992 publisher article was unavailable in the checked route; the 2025 publisher full text also required access.
Previously published Genesio recurrence balances and the period-floor theorem are excluded from the originality claim.
An equivalent short invariant-measure identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Fixed-point barycenter parabola and heightwise forcing calibration in the Genesio flow
